source_scope: Round 50 sequential review of printed Chapters 912–921. Cumulative source-item ledger is EVENT-SOURCE-ITEMS-v5.0.csv. Catalog baseline remains v4.6 with append-only v4.7–v5.0 addenda; fixed schedule unchanged.

confirmed_outcomes.event: The first/northern Frost Oath Great Wall battle begins against three named half-god ice-nest monsters: Bazaar (Ice-Nest Tyrant, level 180), Rift Mountain (Ice-Nest Behemoth, level 175), and Oron (Tzoma's Claw, level 180). No receipt in the reviewed chapter.

Four of four battlefronts resolved; perfect A-rank task completion at 100%. Base payout: Legendary Cross-Region Teleport Array Blueprint x1, Philosopher's Stone x30, Divinity Crystal x50, Divine Power Fragment x200. Perfect-rating bonus: Giant Warrior title and Jormungand·Ice Abyss Ring (unknown quality).

Giant Strong Ale is consumed in dialogue; source panel says restore 30,000 HP over 60 seconds and +1,000 Strength. This is use of an existing consumable, not a newly received item. Chapter discusses a future threat timeline.
Meng Yi requests an alliance against Tzoma and offers two half-god church captives if Mo Yin can break their mind seals; this is an offer, not a completed transfer.

Jormungand·Ice Abyss Ring panel states item level >100, armor range as printed (2431–2252), and a 50% chance on hit to grant ancestor blessing (+10% Strength for 10 seconds). It provides a vague direction to the giant ancestor's death location, not discovery of the body.

Immediate loot transfer lists seven battle materials and elite drops: Ice Dragon Crystal x42, Coldland Rune Stone x38, Dark Energy Orb x3. Narrative separately says expedition-wide Ice Dragon Marks exceed 20 million and Dark Energy Orbs total seven after including prior receipts; those are aggregates, not additional receipts.
Ancient Icefield Giants accept allegiance after their injuries and corruption are healed; recruited forces are a state change, not item receipts.
63 giants receive a combined buff sequence within Nesha's Blessing Aura; no item reward is received. A Seven-Colored Crystal is mentioned as a possible future reinforcement input, not consumed.

Consumes 200 Divine Power Fragments each to purify Echo Godfire and Nightmare Godfire. Then gives Ice Dragon Crystals and Divine Power Fragments to Bron and Malenina for their breakthrough; these are transfers/uses of existing stock, not new receipts.

69shuba page could not be read; accessible Bqquge mirror of printed Ch921 confirms Bron's half-god breakthrough fails (level -20, all attributes -30% for seven days, Icefield divinity -50%), while Malenina succeeds and reaches half-god. No item reward or new receipt.

non_receipts: Chapter 913 reward panel confirms the A-rank task payout; the added title's effects are described in the chapter, but the ledger records it as a title reward, not equipment.
Chapter 917's expedition aggregates (over 20 million Ice Dragon Marks; seven Dark Energy Orbs) are not added on top of individual immediate receipts.
Chapter 914's ale is consumed; Chapter 915's captives are conditional offers; neither is a new item transfer.
Chapter 916's ring clue is only directional and does not confirm recovery of the ancient giant's remains.
Chapter 919's Seven-Colored Crystal is only proposed for later use.
Chapter 920's four-hundred-fragment purification cost and crystal/fragment distributions are transformations/transfers of prior inventory.
Chapter 921 is accessible via the Bqquge mirror despite the 69shuba read failure; its text confirms progression outcomes but no item receipt.

item_receipts.note: Four base mission reward items plus title and unknown-grade ring bonus.
Seven itemized battle materials and three elite-drop categories, as shown in immediate transfer notices.

quest: A-rank Ice and Snow's Choice task is complete at 4/4 and 100% in Ch913; highest task payout and perfect-rating bonus are explicit.
inventory_caveat: All entries are source research, not LL01 starting inventory or guaranteed runtime grants. No in-game event/shop contract is activated.
